get_coco_instances_meta: get COCO instance metadata including 80 thing class names, colors, and contiguous ID mappings
get_coco_panoptic_separated_meta: get COCO panoptic separated metadata with 53 stuff categories and thing-to-stuff ID mappings
get_builtin_metadata_coco: get built-in metadata for the COCO dataset by passing 'coco' as the dataset name
get_builtin_metadata_coco_person: get built-in metadata for COCO person keypoints including flip map and connection rules
get_builtin_metadata_cityscapes: get built-in metadata for the Cityscapes dataset with thing and stuff class lists
